mechanism: Erythromycin may inhibit CYP3A4-mediated metabolism of zidovudine and increase glucuronidation pathway activity, potentially altering zidovudine exposure and increasing risk of hematologic toxicity.
action: Monitor for zidovudine-related adverse effects including anemia and neutropenia; consider alternative macrolide (azithromycin) if prolonged therapy needed, though interaction is generally manageable with monitoring.
